oidc_state_cookie_prefix.description: Cookie prefix for the state cookie.

oidc_session_inactivity_timeout.description: Interval in seconds after which the session will be invalidated when no interaction has occurred.

oidc_authn_header.description: HTTP header variable name to set with the name of the authenticated user.
